subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A petition says many people care.”?
options: Sometimes it only needs to be honest.
A plan shows what can be done.
It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.
The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it only needs to be honest.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A petition says many people care. A plan shows what can be done.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A petition says many people care. A plan shows what can be done.」，答案為「A plan shows what can be done.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A plan shows what can be done.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
